notes: Account: mid-market SaaS (customer engagement/chat product). Product team focused on chat/agent for support use case. Primary interest: Hosted API eval for NA/EU regional latency and smart routing/fallback policies (keep app online if region/zone capacity disrupted). Key eval criteria: streaming latency SLOs (95p sub-200ms for short responses), reliable tool calling (webhook/callouts latency + retries), and regional failover. POC plan: run synthetic latency tests from NA and EU endpoints, measure streaming token latency and tool-call roundtrip times; simulate region outage and validate routing/fallback behavior. Team also cares about cost per convo - will compare Hosted API unit economics vs Dedicated reserved capacity for steady state. "POC success" = meet latency SLO for 95p, deterministic fallback within 2s, and acceptable cost projection (<= estimated_arr_range). Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs, ability to use customer KMS for keys, and clarifications on data residency for EU customers. AE notes: demo went well; product lead said "streaming + tool calling latency is non-negotiable". Next: deliver POC latency matrix, run week-long traffic test, present Dedicated pricing scenarios if POC passes. Open items: final answers on retention controls and EU data residency (security team), clear concurrency targets for dedicated sizing.
